objective: Two axes, two controls: the sources leave the filters menu, and the menu leaves with them.

what_was_deleted.the_menu: the Filters popover, its items, its button, its trigger, its badge, and the WorkbenchMenu::Filters variant
what_was_deleted.the_items: MenuCheckItem and MenuCheckItemProps — a checkable item with a health badge and its own retry, built for the sources alone — and MenuDivider, which only that menu used
what_was_deleted.the_settings: the three source flags the menu read (aur_enabled, flatpak_enabled, appimage_enabled): the view's fields, the config's fields, set_sources_enabled, and the workspace's two calls
what_was_deleted.the_duplicates: SourceRetryHandler was defined three times and SourceToggleHandler once, all in the workbench. Both now live in components/source_bank.rs, the component that owns the axis.

the_discovery.the_menu_could_never_open: the window cannot be narrower than 1024 px (config::MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH) and the sidebar is 190 px expanded, so the content is never under 834 px. WorkbenchBreakpoint::Wide begins at 640: Medium and Narrow are unreachable, and the Filters button — which existed only where the state button was hidden — had no width in which to appear. The sources went, the state has its own button, and the menu had nothing left to hold.
the_discovery.the_choice: delete it. A fallback that cannot fall is not a fallback, and a menu that cannot open is not a control. The narrow layout is recorded as unauthored rather than left as a branch nobody can run.
the_discovery.the_width_floor_is_the_older_decision: MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH arrives with the rename and the breakpoints with UX-02P, and the floor has never been lowered. The pass that decides whether Calix runs narrower than 1024 px will have to author the narrow layout and lower the floor together.
the_discovery.the_measurement: a resize to 640 px was refused by the compositor at 1024 px, which is how the contradiction was found: the screenshot of the 'narrow' window showed the wide toolbar.

the_keyboard.the_bug: menu_item_count and activate_menu_item believed the state menu held four states while the menu drew PackageStateFilter::options_for(scope) — two in Installed, one in Updates. Pressing Down in the Installed scope walked to options that were not on screen, and Enter on the third item set a state the menu never offered.
the_keyboard.the_fix: both ask options_for(scope): the list drawn and the list walked are the same list.
the_keyboard.the_proof: by the rule; the synthetic keyboard of this machine never reaches the client, so no keypress proves it.

the_trap.what_happened: a #[cfg(test)] mod tests with `use super::*` appended to a file that does `use gpui::*` makes the bare #[test] resolve to gpui's attribute macro instead of the built-in one. The macro expands to a #[test] of its own in the same scope, where it resolves to itself: infinite expansion, and rustc dies with SIGSEGV inside libgpui_macros after a stack overflow.
the_trap.the_symptom: cargo build passed; only cargo test --release crashed, because the module was behind #[cfg(test)].
the_trap.the_rule: in a test module under a gpui file, import what it tests by name, or write `use core::prelude::v1::test;` the way components/menu.rs does. Never glob a module that globs gpui while a #[test] is in scope.
the_trap.the_bisect: reverting the file to HEAD made the crash a plain compile error; a minimal module without the glob built; the glob alone was enough to crash.

what_was_seen.the_wide_toolbar: Search, State: All States, Sort: Relevance, the view switcher — no Filters, at 1080 × 935
what_was_seen.the_state_menu: it opens with 'Filter by State' and the two states of the Installed scope (All States, Updates Available); choosing Updates Available turns the label accent-coloured
what_was_seen.the_bank: unchanged, and now the only source control: its apertures toggle and take the accent focus

the_artefacts.what: the menu, its items, its badge and its variant are gone; the state button is the state control at every width
one definition of the retry handler, imported
the Filters keyboard arms gone; menu_item_count and activate_menu_item follow options_for(scope); the three settings fields and set_sources_enabled gone
the two set_sources_enabled calls and the three config fields gone
the SourceAxisEntry re-export had no reader left
A8 proved; the unreachable breakpoints and the keyboard's wrong count recorded as gaps
